name: image_krea2_turbo_style_reference
description: Krea 2 Turbo image style reference. Takes one reference image and a prompt, and generates a new image in the reference's style: the reference is encoded by TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus alongside the prompt, and ostris's krea2_style_reference LoRA steers the 8-step SamplerCustomAdvanced pass (CFGGuider at cfg 1.0, euler/simple). Uses the INT8 checkpoint (~13 GB) and shares the Qwen3-VL encoder and Qwen-Image VAE with image_krea2_turbo_t2i, so running both costs one extra checkpoint and one extra LoRA. `aspect_ratio` and `resolution` size the output canvas — the reference image's own dimensions do not constrain it. Derived from Comfy-Org's image_krea2_turbo_int8_image_style_reference template with the subgraph flattened and the in-workflow LLM prompt enhancement removed.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate in the reference's style.

image.description: Path to the reference image whose style the generation should follow.

lora_strength.description: krea2_style_reference LoRA strength (default 1.0). Lower values let the prompt pull further away from the reference's style.

seed.description: Sampler seed, for reproducing an earlier generation. Omit it and a fresh random seed is used on every submission.

resolution.description: Output size, as the megapixel budget the ResolutionSelector spends on the chosen aspect ratio. Krea 2 is only trained for 1K-2K, so the options stop at 2 MP: '1k' = 1.0 MP (1024x1024 square), '1.5k' = 1.5 MP (1256x1256), '2k' = 2.0 MP (1448x1448). Non-square ratios keep the same pixel budget, e.g. 2k at 16:9 is 1912x1080.
